title: Digitial Product Management Sr Analyst
description:
Overview:

One of PepsiCo’s priorities focus areas in the digital strategy is Sales Effectives. Sales Effectiveness (SE) exists to improve front line performance of daily tasks, increasing sales through prescriptive recommendations for prospecting, selling, servicing, and merchandising. Within SE, there are several digital products being developed. Within SE, there are several digital products being developed. This position is to support Product AiQ and BluePrint. Account IQ will create a common interface for our businesses to drive effectiveness of our Key Account Managers. and BluePrint is an application to enable digital transformation of our AFH Partners. The position of Product Sr. Analyst, AiQ will orchestrate all aspects of product management ranging from supporting the roadmap while also ensuring unified understanding and delivery across teams (architecture, data foundation, service design, operations) and also overseeing the global expansion. This product will serve as the foundational capability and product for our SE transformation to unlock business value via a unified solution.


Responsibilities:

Product Ownership

* Serve as a subject matter expert of our current \& planned AiQ \& BluePrint capabilities
* Facilitate meetings with cross\-functional business and technical teams to gather product requirements and business use cases
* Prioritize and create clear user stories and acceptance criteria day\-by\-day and manage progress through agile ceremonies by working with leads, developers, and scrum masters
* Define, create, and manage the product backlog through weekly backlog sessions
* Manage QA by accepting the completed user stories to make sure the work fulfills the criteria
* Provide feedback at demos related to product delivery, usability, and functionality, and escalate any discrepancies to Product Manager to ensure business goals are met
* Outline PI Objectives and lead validation efforts with all stakeholders; co\-lead PI planning
* In partnership with the Scrum Master, identify risks and concerns for product delivery as related to individual teams
* Surface blockers and provide recommended solutions based on trade\-offs to optimize customer experience, and time\-to\-market
* Clearly communicate goals, roles, responsibilities, and desired outcomes to internal stakeholders and remote teams
* Update Product Documentation as necessary including technical requirements, roadmaps, feature availability, and metadata management




Compensation and Benefits:

* Location, confirmed job\-related skills, experience, and education will be considered in setting actual starting salary. Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range during the hiring process.
* Bonus based on performance and eligibility target payout is 8% of annual salary paid out annually.
* Paid time off subject to eligibility, including paid parental leave, vacation, sick, and bereavement.
* In addition to salary, PepsiCo offers a comprehensive benefits package to support our employees and their families, subject to elections and eligibility: Medical, Dental, Vision, Disability, Health, and Dependent Care Reimbursement Accounts, Employee Assistance Program (EAP), Insurance (Accident, Group Legal, Life), Defined Contribution Retirement Plan.

  


Qualifications:
* BA or MBA in Business Management or a related field
* 9\+ years of work experience as a Product Analyst / Owner bringing software products to market
* Agile methodology experience from defining user stories, to sizing, Sprint Planning and Sprint Execution to go live and hyper care
* Strong communicator with excellent people skills to interact with various teams inside the company, clients, and vendors.
* Metrics\-driven: strong analytical and synthesis skills (both qualitative \& quantitative), including the ability to absorb and process large amounts of data into actionable information
* Undergraduate degree required, ideally in technical or process focused areas
* Business curiosity via related leadership experience

title: QA Engineer - O2C & Enterprise Billing Testing
description:
We are a global team of innovators and pioneers dedicated to shaping the future of observability. At New Relic, we build an intelligent platform that empowers companies to thrive in an AI\-first world by giving them unparalleled insight into their complex systems. As we continue to expand our global footprint, we're looking for passionate people to join our mission. If you're ready to help the world's best companies optimize their digital applications, we invite you to explore a career with us!


We are looking for a highly analytical and technically proficient QA Engineer to take ownership of our Opportunity\-to\-Cash (O2C) and Enterprise Billing testing. In this role, you will act as a quality gatekeeper for the financial systems that drive our business.



You will join the BOBA Frameworks QA team — a small, high\-ownership team embedded in the Finance engineering organization — where quality directly impacts revenue accuracy and customer trust.



You will not just be executing test cases; you will be mapping out complex data flows that span across Salesforce CPQ, our middleware, our Billing Platform, our payment gateways (Braintree), and our NetSuite ERP. If you are a critical thinker who understands the financial domino effect of a failed sync, loves unraveling usage\-based billing logic, and thrives in cross\-functional collaboration, we want you on our team.


**What You Will Do (Key Responsibilities)**
===========================================


* **End\-to\-End Pipeline Ownership:**
* + Execute comprehensive test strategies for our entire Opportunity\-to\-Cash lifecycle.
	+ Trace data payloads from the moment an order is created in Salesforce CPQ to the moment the final journal entry hits NetSuite.
* **Complex Billing Lifecycle Validation:**
* + Take ownership of testing our Enterprise Billing Platform.
	+ Rigorously validate invoice generation, taxation (Avalara), proration, discounts, credits, tiered and usage\-based pricing models, credit memo issuances, and dunning (collections) workflows.
* **Test Plan \& Coverage Ownership:**
* + Own and maintain structured test plans in Xray for all buying programs (PAYG, Savings Plan, Volume Plan).
	+ Ensure traceability from requirements to execution across every billing lifecycle stage.
* **Payment Gateway \& Ledger Allocation Testing:**
* + Take ownership of end\-to\-end payment flows through Braintree.
	+ Validate successful authorizations, settlements, and complex edge cases like partial refunds on multi\-invoice payments.
	+ Ensure funds are accurately handled (e.g., proper allocation vs. unallocated amounts) and invoice statuses remain correct across systems.
* **Usage \& Consumption Testing:**
* + Deep\-dive into our usage\-based billing models.
	+ Simulate high\-volume usage data, validate tier drawdown logic, and ensure overages are calculated with absolute precision.
* **Cross\-System Integration Testing:**
* + Perform robust integration testing across our financial tech stack.
	+ Validate API payloads, investigate failed background syncs, and ensure data integrity between Salesforce, Billing Platform, NetSuite, and Braintree.
* **Defect Triage \& Root Cause Analysis:**
* + Investigate system logs and identify exactly where a data sync broke down.
	+ Provide developers with clear, actionable reproduction steps beyond just reporting bugs.
* **Cross\-Functional Collaboration:**
* + Act as the bridge between Engineering, Product, and Finance.Partner with business stakeholders to understand complex revenue rules and translate them into foolproof test scenarios.

**What Success Looks Like (Your First Year)**
=============================================


* **Day 30 — Architecture \& Ownership:** You've mapped the full Quote\-to\-Cash pipeline end\-to\-end: Salesforce CPQ Boomi/PASS provisioning Billing Platform NetSuite Avalara \& Braintree. You've taken full ownership of the Xray test repository and can explain which test cases cover which buying program, workstream, and billing lifecycle stage without being asked.
* **Day 60 — Independent Execution:** You independently execute QA for a complete enterprise billing lifecycle — from contract activation through invoice approval, tax calculation, and payment processing — and close it without escalation. You've begun triaging Billing Platform NetSuite sync failures and Boomi provisioning errors on your own, and you understand the difference between a defect and expected system behavior.
* **Day 90 — Primary Sign\-Off:** You are the QA gate for all cross\-system financial deployments. Engineering ships nothing that touches CPQ, Billing Platform, or NetSuite without your sign\-off. You've established a defect triage process in Jira and Xray that gives Engineering and Finance a shared, real\-time view of quality — eliminating the back\-and\-forth that slows down deployments.
* **Year 1 — Measurable Impact:** Critical post\-deployment data sync errors between CPQ and NetSuite have dropped measurably. Every active buying program — PAYG, Savings Plan, and Volume Plan — has standardized, Xray\-tracked test coverage for usage\-based billing, commitment invoicing, contract lifecycle boundaries, and edge cases. The team ships faster because QA is a multiplier, not a bottleneck.

**What You Bring to the Table (Required Experience)**
=====================================================


* **O2C Domain Expertise:** 4\+ years of QA experience with a heavy focus on Quote\-to\-Cash / Order\-to\-Cash business processes. You understand the "why" behind financial transactions, not just the "how."
* **Salesforce CPQ:** Hands\-on experience configuring and testing quotes, product bundles, amendments, and contract renewals within Salesforce CPQ.
* **Enterprise Billing Platforms:** Proven experience testing complex billing systems such as BillingPlatform, Zuora, or similar financial engines.
* **Payment Processing \& Gateways:** Hands\-on experience testing enterprise payment gateways (Braintree heavily preferred; Stripe or Adyen acceptable). You possess a deep functional understanding of payment lifecycles (Auth, Capture, Settle, Refund) and how gateway actions impact Accounts Receivable (AR) balances.
* **Integration Middleware:** Familiarity with provisioning and event\-driven middleware (Boomi or equivalent). You can read a payload log and identify where in the chain a sync broke.
* **Test Management \& Agile Tools:** Proficient in Jira for defect tracking and Agile workflows, with strong hands\-on experience using Xray as a test management tool. You know how to navigate structured test plans, manage test executions, and maintain strict traceability between bugs, test cases, and product requirements.
* **Usage\-Based Models:** Familiarity with testing consumption\-based pricing, tiered pricing, drawdown models, and metered billing logic.
* **Integration \& API Verification:** Experience validating data transfers between systems (using tools like Postman or validating middleware logs). You know how to prove a system sent the right data even if the UI hasn't updated yet.
* **Taxation \& Compliance Tools:** Familiarity with enterprise taxation calculation software like Avalara.

**Who You Are (Soft Skills)**
=============================


* **A System\-Level Thinker:** You understand that missing a prerequisite step — like failing to approve a usage invoice before uploading the next month's consumption — breaks the entire downstream flow.
* **Self\-Driven Investigator:** When a test fails, you don't just throw it back to Dev. You dig into the documentation and logs to help figure out exactly what went wrong.
* **Exceptional Communicator:** You can clearly explain a complex API sync failure to an engineer, and then turn around and explain the business impact of that failure to a Finance Manager.
* **Detail\-Obsessive Under Ambiguity:** Financial test data is rarely clean. You know how to set up a controlled test environment, isolate variables, and still reach a confident pass/fail verdict even when upstream systems are noisy.

title: Quality Analyst
description:
**About FYI**


FYI is a product\-led SaaS company built by accountants, for accountants. Our platform unifies cloud document management, automation and practice management into one intuitive solution, helping firms eliminate manual processes and focus on higher\-value work.


Behind our product is The FYI Way \- our operating system built on clarity, consistency and excellence. We scale with structured processes, automation and AI, clear expectations and measurable outcomes that keep teams aligned and performing at a world\-class standard.

**The position**


We’re looking for an experienced Quality Analyst to join FYI. This is a full\-time contracted position, with remuneration paid on an hourly basis for all hours worked.


Reporting to the Quality Manager, you'll play a key role in ensuring new features and product enhancements are delivered to the highest quality standards before reaching our clients.


Working closely with Product and Engineering teams, you'll take ownership of testing across new platform features and platform enhancements.


**Key responsibilities**

* Plan, execute and maintain testing across FYI’s document management, practice management and automation features.
* Review requirements and acceptance criteria with Product and Engineering to identify test scenarios and potential gaps before development is completed.
* Perform functional, regression and exploratory testing to validate new features, enhancements and bug fixes.
* Work closely with Developers to investigate defects, validate fixes and confirm features are ready for release.
* Contribute to improving QA processes, testing practices and overall product reliability.

**About you**

* Experience working effectively in a fully remote environment.
* 8\+ years' experience as a Quality Analyst within a SaaS or software development environment.
* Strong verbal and written English communication skills, with the ability to communicate clearly and effectively with colleagues across Australia, New Zealand and the UK.
* Experience working within fast Agile development environments.
* Experience applying context\-driven software testing methodologies.

**How to apply**


To be considered for this position, address your Resume to FYI Careers and clearly outline your manual and automation testing experience.


Our promise is a fair and considerate recruitment process. You'll always hear an outcome from us, and we'll share feedback where we can.
